text:
joe: FYI saw repeat EDGE_TIMEOUT_504 pages between 02:05-02:40 UTC last 4 nights. Small burst every ~20m from same region. Screenshots attached.
priya: Any infra changes during that window?
joe: Nothing in deploys. deploy-bot shows no pushes.
nate: Could be an intermittent backend pool exhaustion or a noisy healthcheck path. Do we have path breakdowns?
ada: I pulled logs: majority are /search/sync and backend cluster search-shard-b. Also lots of identical client_ip hashes which suggests a traffic spike from a crawl.
priya: This alert currently pages P1 immediately on any 504 rate > 0.1% in 1m. That's too eager for bursty traffic. Recommend two steps: 1) adjust alert to 5m sustained window and require >0.3% and 2) add dedupe/grouping so we don't page on the same fingerprint repeatedly.
nate: I can own the dedupe rule in alertmanager: group by backend_cluster + request_path. I'll add a relabel to normalize path params. ETA 10 days.
joe: I'll do the quick threshold tweak today. I'll open INF-2601 and run in staging.
oncall-bot: New ticket created: INF-2601 - tune EDGE_TIMEOUT_504 alert 1 assigned to @joe, due in 2 days.
priya: Also propose a paging policy exception: reduce overnight paging level to page only if 504 rate >1% OR if error rate + CPU > 75% across proxies. This avoids wakeups for small crawls. Can someone add this to paging-policy repo?
ada: I've got a small script to fingerprint by normalizing /search/sync?cursor=... -> /search/sync. I'll attach it to the dedupe PR.
ate: Draft PromQL for the tuned alert (testing):
```
- alert: EdgeTimeoutsSustained
  expr: increase(edge_responses_total{code="504"}[5m]) / increase(edge_requests_total[5m]) > 0.003
  for: 8m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
This should avoid 1m blips and require a sustained window.
priya: Make sure the alert text includes a short troubleshooting checklist: check backend pool, recent bursts by client_ip, and proxy CPU. Link runbook: /runbook/alerts/edge_timeouts.
joe: Opening quick PR for threshold change and staging test. PR includes rollback notes.
deploy-bot: Staging rollout started: edge-proxy-canary v3.2 by @joe.
oncall-bot: INF-2601 updated: PR open, staging tests passing.
pagerduty-bot: Page suppression rule candidate: suppress EDGE_TIMEOUT_504 pages between 00:00-07:00 UTC unless error_rate>1% OR proxy_cpu>75%. Suggested by @priya.
ada: I'll own the log sampling job to capture the offending client_ips for RCA. ETA 5 days. Ticket INF-2610 created for that.
priya: Recap: INF-2601 (joe) quick tune, due 2d; INF-2610 (nada) log sampling + RCA, due 5d; INF-2633 (nate) dedupe/grouping + normalized path relabel, due 10d; DOC-89 (priya) update paging policy and runbook blurb, due 4d.
joe: Early evidence: canary shows no pages after change. Will monitor overnight and update tickets tomorrow.
ate: I'll include unit tests for fingerprinting in the alertmanager staging instance.
priya: Thanks team. We should add an entry to the recurring-incident tracker so we remember to check this next month. I'll add a digest note. :ok_hand:
